welcome.body:
🙏🏻 Welcome to *Whybee*! I create personalised content for you.

Here are some popular options 👇🏻
resume.filter.body: 📄 Great choice! Do you want a resume *with* a photo, *without* a photo, or see *both* options?
resume.samples.singleImageCaption: All 9 templates: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto
resume.samples.introBeforeList:
We have 9 templates in the picture above.

In the *next message*, tap *Choose* to open the list and pick one 👇🏻
resume.photo.received: ✅ Got your photo! I'll use it on your resume. Send any more details or type *done* when you're ready to see the summary.
resume.color.bgIntro: We have more background colour options. Pick one 👇🏻
resume.color.textIntro: Single background; you can pick any accent colour 👇🏻
resume.inputMethod.prompt: How would you like to start?
resume.upload.sendPdf: 📄 Send your resume PDF and I'll read it.
resume.review.prompt:
📄 Review your details above.

✏️ If you want to edit, send all your changes in a *_SINGLE MESSAGE_*.

✅ If you don't want to edit and are happy with the details, type *_DONE_*.
errors.pdfParseFailed: 😔 I couldn't read that PDF. Try another file or choose *Build from scratch*.
errors.pdfNotDocument: Please send a PDF document (not a photo).
usecase.body: Pick the style you'd love for your {productName} 👇🏻
usecase.bodyResumeAfterImages: Pick the style you'd love for your Resume
confirm.nudge: 👆🏻 Tap one of the buttons above to continue.
confirm.editPrompt: ✏️ What would you like to change? Just tell me and I'll update it right away.
confirm.editNotUnderstood: 🤔 I couldn't tell which part to update. Try: "Change the summary to: [your new summary]" or "Update experience to: [new text]".
resume.confirm.missingOptional:
You didn't provide: {list}.

Is that okay? Tap *Looks good* to proceed or tell us what to add or change.
form.required: 📋 Please complete the form first, then we can continue!
form.photo.progress: 📸 Got it! ({current}/{max}) Send more photos or type *done* when ready.
form.photo.done: ✅ Perfect, that's all the photos we need!
form.photo.required: 📸 Please send at least one photo first.
form.photo.request: 📸 Now send your photos (1–3), then type *done* when you're ready.
fulfillment.previewPrompt: 👆🏻 Your preview is ready! Take a look and pick an option.
fulfillment.payment: 🎉 Happy with your preview? Your final file — clean, crisp, and watermark-free — will arrive right here on WhatsApp the moment you pay.
fulfillment.editFromPreview: ✏️ Got it — tell me what you'd like to change and I'll update your preview.
fulfillment.delivering: 🎉 Thank you so much! Your file is on its way — we hope it's everything you imagined. Wishing you all the very best 💫
status.generating: ⏳ Still working on it, hang tight!
status.awaitingPayment: ✨ Please complete your payment using the link sent above.
errors.generic: 😔 Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.outputFailed: ⚠️ Something went wrong generating your file. Please contact support.
errors.voiceNoteNotAccepted: 🙏 We don't accept voice notes for now. Please type your message.
feedback.thanks: 💛 Thank you so much — your feedback truly means the world to us. We hope to create something special for you again soon 🌟
